environment.description: Application deployed on EC2 instance behind an Application Load Balancer with default settings. ALB forwards all HTTP traffic to the application on port 8080. Security group allows inbound on port 443 from 0.0.0.0/0. No additional request filtering or inspection layers. SQLite database stored on local EBS volume with standard ext4 filesystem.

config.alb: internet-facing, default listener rules, no WAF association
config.database: SQLite 3.40 on local EBS gp3 volume
